description: This file contains the implementation of the AsyncEnumerableGrainExtension class, which provides support for returning IAsyncEnumerable<T> from grain methods in Orleans. It manages enumerator states, handles asynchronous iteration, cleanup, and disposal, and integrates with Orleans timers and context.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainExtension
classes.description: A sealed class providing support for async enumerable grain methods, managing enumerator lifecycle, state, and integration with Orleans timers and diagnostics.

classes.name: EnumeratorState
classes.description: A struct representing the state of an individual enumerator, including flags, the enumerator instance, move-next task, batch size, and cancellation token source.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing the extension with grain context, messaging options, and logger, and setting up a timer for cleanup.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes all enumerators and the internal timer.

methods.name: RemoveExpiredAsync
methods.description: Removes and disposes expired enumerators based on internal flags and timing.

methods.name: StartEnumeration
methods.description: Starts a new asynchronous enumeration, setting up the enumerator and initial state.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the enumerator for a given request ID, returning the next element or status.

methods.name: MoveNextCore
methods.description: Core logic to move to the next element in the enumerator, handling synchronous and asynchronous cases.

methods.name: AwaitMoveNextAsync
methods.description: Awaits the move-next task, handles timeouts, and updates enumerator state accordingly.

methods.name: RemoveEnumeratorAsync
methods.description: Removes and disposes a specific enumerator by request ID.

methods.name: OnTerminateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup after enumeration terminates, removing the enumerator and returning status.

methods.name: DisposeEnumeratorAsync
methods.description: Disposes an enumerator, cancelling its token and disposing the underlying enumerator.

methods.name: OnAsyncEnumeratorGrainExtensionCreated
methods.description: Diagnostic hook invoked when the extension is created.

methods.name: OnEnumeratorCleanupCompleted
methods.description: Diagnostic hook invoked after cleanup completes.
